domainName: Domain 1: Threat Detection and Incident Response
scenario: An organization is operating a enterprise workload for GuardDuty Threat Intelligence. The engineering team needs to satisfy AWS architectural best practices regarding Domain 1: Threat Detection and Incident Response. Which architectural design fulfills these requirements with minimal operational overhead?

options.text: Implement GuardDuty Threat Intelligence using AWS recommended managed architecture with automated multi-AZ failover and IAM encryption.
Deploy self-managed EC2 instances running custom scripts to sync data without leveraging AWS native IAM authentication.
Configure AWS CloudWatch alarms with automated EventBridge targets for continuous governance of GuardDuty Threat Intelligence.
Utilize manual snapshots exported to local storage on a periodic schedule without KMS key rotation.

explanation: According to the official AWS Certified Security – Specialty (SCS-C02) exam blueprint, option(s) A align with AWS best practices for Domain 1: Threat Detection and Incident Response and GuardDuty Threat Intelligence.
